answer: The strongest sybil defense is quorum sampling of graders drawn only from long-lived identities with stake at risk. Each task randomly samples a quorum from that pool, scanning the ocean of claims through many independent judges instead of one. New accounts dawn into the system but cannot join a quorum until they build standing. A mesa of reputation must be climbed first. Fake identities are never sampled, so flooding gains nothing; corrupting a quorum means buying costly aged accounts whose stake and reputation evaporate on first detection.
